## Reading
- Per-uid temp folder: join(ym(), "claude-<uid>"), where ym() = CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR or "/tmp". It is created with mode 0700 and then opened O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW to check its owner.
- On macOS the general temp lookup skips TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP (the r==="macos" branch) and falls back to "/tmp" unless CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is set.
- Sandboxed commands get TMPDIR = CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR || CLAUDE_TMPDIR || "/tmp/claude".
- The client strips trailing slashes from its temp roots.
- Unproven, for the record only: the run-#2/startup 55-byte stderr line has the length of "EPERM: operation not permitted, open '/tmp/claude-501'" plus a newline.
